title: Director's power to direct convening of extraordinary meeting of Gram Sabha

versions.Latest: 5-A. Director's power to direct convening of extraordinary meeting of Gram Sabha.— The Director of Panchayats may also, by order in writing, direct the Sarpanch to convene an extraordinary meeting of the Gram Sabha if in the opinion of the Director such a meeting is necessary in public interest. In case the Sarpanch fails, the Block Development Officer shall convene it within fifteen days.
